Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Cedar Hill Associates Boosted Its Discovery Comm C (DISCK) Position by $4.55 Million as Stock Price Declined; Sabra Health Care Reit (SBRA) Holder Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Has Increased Position 
April 20, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Cedar Hill Associates Llc increased its stake in Discovery Comm C (DISCK) by 211.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cedar Hill Associates Llc bought 216,490 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.19% with the market. The hedge fund held 318,780 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.75M, up from 102,290 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cedar Hill Associates Llc who had been investing in Discovery Comm C for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.03B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.66% or $0.36   $21.27. About 1.88M shares traded. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) has declined 27.22%   downtrending.   38.77% the S&P500. 
Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Sabra Health Care Reit Inc (SBRA) by 80.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc bought 19,951 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,640 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $838,000, up from 24,689 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Sabra Health Care Reit Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.06 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.28% or $0.4   $17.14. About 687,388 shares traded. Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) has declined 38.98%   downtrending.   50.53% the S&P500. 
Cedar Hill Associates Llc, which manages about $1.20B and $574.62M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Computer (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6,158 shares to 86,083 shares, valued at $14.57 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Calpine Corp (NYSE:CPN) by 49,150 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 478,255 shares, and cut its stake in Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc (NYSE:TMO). 
Since March 22, 2018, it had 0 insider purchases, and 1 sale for $10,416 activity. 
Among 15 analysts covering Sabra Health Care REIT ( NASDAQ:SBRA ), 7 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 47% are positive. Sabra Health Care REIT had 51 analyst reports since July 21,   The stock has “Outperform” rating by FBR Capital on Tuesday, February 23. The stock of Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) has “Hold” rating given on Friday, September 15 by Stifel Nicolaus. SunTrust maintained Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) on Monday, January 22 with “Buy” rating. FBR Capital maintained Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) rating on Tuesday, November 10. FBR Capital has “Outperform” rating and $26 target. The company was downgraded on Thursday, May 19 by Mizuho. The stock of Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (NASDAQ:SBRA) has “Market Perform” rating given on Tuesday, March 20 by Wells Fargo. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, October 8 by FBR Capital. The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Wednesday, November 11 by Barclays Capital. Jefferies maintained it with “Buy” rating and $25.0 target in Monday, September 18 report. Bank of America downgraded the shares of SBRA in report on Monday, November 2 to “Neutral” rating. 
Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc, which manages about $3.42B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Integrated Device Technology (NASDAQ:IDTI) by 10,694 shares to 33,876 shares, valued at $1.01M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Lam Research Corp (NASDAQ:LRCX) by 2,018 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 6,475 shares, and cut its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (NYSE:BABA). -   Hazel Jackson
